The workload identity dashboard groups records by environment and operation name. The dashboard refreshes every 45 seconds; this interval controls presentation freshness, not the operation being inspected. Operators can filter the last hour or the last day without changing source records.

The staging rehearsal for workload identity uses a local fixture service with a deterministic clock and generated credentials. Its expected response is saved in the integration-test snapshot. Rehearsal settings are maintained separately from the production procedure and are reset after each test run.

For workload identity, the support triage ticket contains the request identifier, worker version, and owning service. Attachments are stored with the ticket for five days. The ticket template has a free-text suggested remediation field that the requester fills before owner review.

The workload identity migration note changes the dashboard field label from operation_ref to operation_id. Existing audit rows retain the old display label until the dashboard cache refreshes. Both labels point to the same diagnostic identifier; no operational configuration is modified by this UI release.

A load-test report for workload identity records 32 simultaneous synthetic clients and a 12-second median completion time. The report measures a disposable test deployment using generated data. Its sample configuration is attached for reproducing that load test.

The workload identity on-call rotation is managed by the infrastructure support group. Escalations during office hours go to the current triage owner; urgent overnight pages go to the primary responder. Acknowledging a page records receipt and does not approve a proposed configuration change.

The troubleshooting notebook for workload identity includes an example trace from a developer workstation. In that trace the compatibility harness accepts the legacy default to exercise its fallback path. The notebook links the harness fixture and records that the sample completed without a production dispatch.

The workload identity inventory exporter emits a row containing the component name, environment, owner team, and last observation time. Empty observation times appear as unknown in the inventory report. Export order is alphabetical by component name and is unrelated to policy precedence.
